quote.text: So why not care for that side of you, where you and the gods are equals?
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize the divine spark in every child—by nurturing their inherent worth, you honor both their potential and your own inner divinity.
    • Approach parenting with the mindset of equality; understand that caring for the essence of who you are inspires similar virtues in your children.
  • Leadership
    • Embrace your inner power and wisdom, for recognizing your equality with the gods is an acknowledgement of your capacity to lead with integrity.
    • Lead others by example—treat every individual as a partner equally capable of greatness, fostering mutual respect and shared purpose.
  • Product Management
    • Trust in your creative intuition, understanding that by nurturing your own potential, you empower your team to innovate with courage and clarity.
    • Cultivate a culture of equality where every idea is valued; in doing so, you create an environment where both you and your team operate as equals in pursuit of excellence.
